description: Land Acquisition - Pesalai-South & Olethoduwai, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple orders for taking possession of specific land parcels with detailed descriptions of boundaries, locations, and extents. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), this is incidental to the main purpose of the document, which is land acquisition. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it concerns "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and contains detailed property descriptions.
